RIGHT FOR YOU?

Is Dental Implant Treatment Right for You?

You may be a good candidate for dental implants if you experience any of the following:

Missing Tooth
Loose Denture
Difficulty Chewing
Gaps in Your Smile
Jawbone Loss or Bone Loss Concerns
Difficulty Speaking Clearly
Broken or Severely Damaged Tooth
Tired of Temporary Tooth Replacement Options
ANATOMY OF A DENTAL IMPLANT

Structural Components of a Dental Implant

An implant system replicates the entire anatomy of a healthy natural tooth:

1

The Titanium Post

The Root

This screw-like device is surgically placed below the gumline into the upper or lower jawbone. Titanium is highly biocompatible, allowing the bone to naturally fuse to its surface via a process called osseointegration.

2

The Abutment

The Connector

A hidden structural piece placed over the gumline that secures the final crown to the integrated metal post.

3

The Crown

The Visible Tooth

The hard, aesthetically superior ceramic surface that sits above the gumline, carefully sculpted to look like a real tooth and provide an optimal surface for chewing.

Everything You Need to Know

Dental implants are titanium posts placed into the jawbone to replace missing tooth roots. They provide a strong foundation for crowns, bridges, or dentures, restoring both function and appearance.

Most adults with healthy gums and adequate jawbone density are good candidates. Our implant specialists will evaluate your oral health and recommend the most suitable treatment plan.

Dental implant placement is performed under local anesthesia, ensuring a comfortable experience. Mild discomfort after the procedure is normal and typically subsides within a few days.

With proper oral hygiene and regular dental check-ups, dental implants can last for decades and, in many cases, a lifetime.

The cost depends on factors such as the number of implants, the implant system used, and whether additional procedures like bone grafting are required. A consultation provides a personalized treatment plan and cost estimate.

The treatment usually takes 3–6 months, depending on your healing process and whether additional procedures are needed before implant placement.

Dantam Dental Clinics combines experienced implant specialists, advanced 3D digital technology, personalized treatment planning, and premium implant systems to deliver safe, precise, and long-lasting smile restoration.
